title: Keep the first item per key
spec: Implement unique_by(items, key). items is a list and key is a function returning hashable values. Return a new list with exactly one item for each distinct key(item): the first item in items having that key, placed in the order in which keys first appear. Do not modify items.
target_defect: A dictionary comprehension keeps the first position of each key but the last item with that key.
author_rationale: Replace the quadratic membership scan with a dictionary.
limitations: Synthetic module written by the repository's AI engineering agent after the November 2026 development pilot saturated corpus v1, before any model reviewed it.
